title: The diagonal Cartier class from its full Kummer adjunct
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and invertible on $Y$. Put $W=\mathbf P^1_Y\times_Y\mathbf P^1_Y$ and let $i:\mathbf P^1_Y\hookrightarrow W$ be the diagonal [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. For $n\geq0$ let $R=\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1}$, let $Q=i_*R$, and let $P=R(1)$. Let $g$ be the supported integral generator, $\delta$ the positive integral diagonal boundary, and $\kappa$ the positive Kummer unit preceded by the units comparison, named kummerComparedUnit [lem-sfb-kummer-strict-target-transport]. For any $e\in\operatorname{Ext}^2_R(Q,P)$ [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data], if the scalar adjunct of $e$ along $g$ equals $-\delta\kappa$, then $e$ is the canonical residue Cartier class cartierResidueReducedPro. Any proof that $\ell$ is a unit on $W$ may be used in $\kappa$; it is supplied by pullback from $Y$. There is no derived reduction presentation or strict-system datum in this statement. The real family definition diagonalResidueClasses specializes the existing unique Cartier classes with the named coefficient structures, without choosing any new witness.

proof.text: Unfold the real kummerScalarAdjunct, negativeExtProduct and kummerComparedUnit expressions. Expand the integral boundary as the negative transported pole boundary; Ext bilinearity cancels both negative signs. Associativity gives exactly the positive full Cartier scalar-adjunct equation.

The resulting equation is precisely the full scalar-adjunct equation in the canonical Cartier API. The positive prime-power residue ring is finite. Apply canonical_cartier_class_of_adjunct and identify its explicit family with diagonalResidueClasses.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_cartier_class_of_adjunct (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (hY : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤))) (n : ℕ)
    (e : Ext.{u + 1}
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n))
        (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
          (geoCartierConstant (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (geoCartierLine (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (ℓ ^ (n + 1))
        (cartierResidue_cast ℓ (n + 1)) (diagonalSurface Y)) 2)
    (he : kummerScalarAdjunct (A := DiagonalAb (diagonalSurface Y))
      (cartierForget (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (diagonalSurface Y))
      (cartierProIntegralGenerator (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) (diagonalImmersion Y)) e =
      negativeExtProduct (diagonalIntegralBoundary Y)
        (kummerComparedUnit ℓ (diagonalSurface Y) hW n)) :
    e = diagonalResidueClasses ℓ Y hY n
